## MindRails · n8n fulfilment reference
Eight synthetic cases. No shop login, real shipping label, email or customer data.
Start the local fixture service first. Repeat execution to inspect replay behavior.
The mock API owns the durable demo ledger; n8n static data is not an idempotency lock.
See README for validation, limits and production requirements.
